info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Custody Administration Management API
info.description: The Custody Administration Management API allows financial institutions to efficiently manage and update custody operations related to market transactions. This API supports modifications to key aspects of custody administration, enabling users to ensure compliance and accuracy in their financial operations. Typical consumers include banking professionals, portfolio managers, and compliance officers who require real-time adjustments to custody records. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational workflows while ensuring robust management of assets.
